_doc: Generated-only replacement placement spec. Heading anchors were retained from the original reviewed placement file.

figures.alt: Luxury vinyl plank layout over underlayment with expansion spacers at the wall
figures.caption: Check the substrate, manufacturer requirements, perimeter gaps, and layout before the first row locks together. Straight courses and room transitions are set at the beginning, not rescued at the end.

figures.alt: Concrete floor condition prepared for assessment before a finish is added
figures.caption: Flatness and moisture conditions matter beneath any floating floor. This concrete example is an inspection cue: assess the actual substrate and correct active defects before covering it.

figures.alt: Interior baseboard trim staged for a clean finished-floor edge
figures.caption: Leave the required expansion space, then use trim to cover the perimeter without pinning the floating floor. Finish details should protect the movement allowance rather than eliminate it.
